name: dia-text-reveal
title: Dia Text Reveal
description: A band of colours sweeps left to right across hidden text and leaves it in its final colour (1.5 s, ease-in-out cubic); with several phrases it rotates through them.

moworks.author: magicui

options.texts: list of phrases (the element's own text)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Phrases change on a fixed schedule (duration + repeatDelay); widths are measured once. The band reaches past the letters, so marks above Vietnamese capitals are coloured too.
moworks.titleVi: Dải màu quét lộ chữ (kiểu Dia)
